integrity: Proof specifies every rank stratum and arbitrary-field count; independent implementations exhaust the binary radical and all quaternary quadratic parts, with seeded nonhomogeneous checks. Finite checks are supplementary, and independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Four square-zero generators over finite fields of characteristic two; distribution for the regular module and its radical only. Full historical priority of the exact rank polynomial and Pfaffian locus description is not independently certified.
title: Pfaffian Jordan strata in the four-generator binary complete intersection
